en.title: Street Fighter 2026: WWE Stars and Hollywood Heavyweights Collide
en.summary: Get ready for a knockout! A new live-action 'Street Fighter' movie is gearing up to bring the iconic game to life with a star-studded cast that blends wrestling titans and familiar faces.
en.body:
Round one... fight! The world of fighting games is about to collide with the squared circle and Hollywood's A-list in the upcoming **Street Fighter** film. Set to hit screens in 2026, this new adaptation promises a vibrant, action-comedy take on Capcom's legendary franchise, transporting us back to the neon-drenched, high-stakes world of a global fighting tournament.

Helmed by director Kitao Sakurai, known for his distinctive visual style, the film boasts a cast that reads like a dream match. **Noah Centineo** steps into the ring as the charismatic Ken Masters, while **Andrew Koji** embodies the stoic intensity of Ryu. The roster is stacked with formidable presences from the world of professional wrestling: **Joe "Roman Reigns" Anoa’i** is set to unleash the devastating power of Akuma, and **Cody Rhodes** will bring his fighting spirit to the role of Guile. Adding to the muscle and mayhem are **Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson** as the formidable Balrog and **Jason Momoa** channeling the wild energy of Blanka. The film also features **David Dastmalchian** as the menacing M. Bison, **Vidyut Jammwal** as the yogi warrior Dhalsim, and **Olivier Richters** as the towering Zangief. Rounding out this impressive ensemble are **Hirooki Goto** as E. Honda, **Andrew Schulz** as Dan Hibiki, **Eric André** as Don Sauvage, **Mel Jarnson** as Cammy, **Orville Peck** as Vega, and **Callina Liang** as Chun-Li.

This casting strategy is a clear power-up for fans. By integrating established stars from WWE and UFC alongside beloved actors, the film aims to capture the raw energy and larger-than-life personas that define the **Street Fighter** universe. It’s a move that acknowledges the deep connection fans have with these characters, promising authentic portrayals that honor the game's legacy while injecting fresh star power. The inclusion of wrestling icons like Roman Reigns and Cody Rhodes, known for their intense physicality and crowd engagement, suggests a commitment to visceral fight choreography that fans expect. This isn't just about recognizable faces; it's about embodying the spirit of these iconic fighters.

## What to Expect from the Fight

The plot centers on a worldwide fighting tournament, a classic setup that allows for a diverse array of characters and fighting styles to be showcased. From Blanka's electric powers to Akuma's Raging Demon, the film is poised to bring the signature moves of the **Street Fighter** series to life with modern cinematic flair. Director Kitao Sakurai and screenwriter T. J. Fixman have the challenging task of balancing action, comedy, and character development for such a large ensemble, a feat that could result in a truly unique cinematic experience.

## The Legacy Continues

This marks the third live-action feature film based on Capcom's seminal video game series, which first captivated audiences in arcades back in the 1980s. The anticipation is palpable, as fans have been eager for a definitive live-action adaptation that captures the magic of the games. The blend of martial arts, global competition, and larger-than-life characters makes **Street Fighter** ripe for a big-screen revival, and this cast is certainly poised to deliver a spectacle.

## What's Next

With filming underway and a 2026 release date on the horizon, details about the official trailer and promotional tour are expected to emerge in the coming months. Keep your eyes peeled for more electrifying announcements as this ultimate fighting game movie nears its premiere.
